title: One Piece
blurb: As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of the buccaneer "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber...at the cost of never being able to swim again! Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure...one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world...

title: SPY x FAMILY
blurb:
The master spy codenamed <Twilight> has spent his days on undercover missions, all for the dream of a better world. But one day, he receives a particularly difficult new order from command. For his mission, he must form a temporary family and start a new life?! A Spy/Action/Comedy about a one-of-a-kind family!

Notes:
- Nominated for the 24th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2020.
- Nominated for the 13th and 14th Manga Taisho Award in 2020 and 2021.
- Nominated for the 44th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2020.

title: Kagurabachi
blurb:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.


Note:
- Winner of the Tsugimanga 2024 Award in the Print Manga Category. 
- Winner of the 4th Magademy Commitment Award. 
- Nominee of the 70th Shogakukan Award.

title: Sakamoto Days
blurb: Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! The chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

title: Ichi the Witch
blurb:
Magic is alive and well in the world, inside beings known as Majiks. By completing a Majik’s trial, a Witch can gain its power. However, only women can become Witches or use magical items. All that changes one day when a young man named Ichi turns the world on its head by defeating an infamous Majik and gaining its magical powers!



Notes:
- Winner of the 2025 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.
- Ranked 11th in Da Vinci's 2025 Book of the Year ranking.
- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.
- Ranked 10th in the 19th Manga Taisho in 2026.
- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2026.

title: My Sister's Best Friend
blurb: Hina, Asahi's older sister's best friend, is always hanging around the house he shares with his sister. She's unbelievably beautiful, irresistibly cute... and has absolutely no sense of personal space. Before he knows it, Asahi—a nerdy high school boy—is completely swept up into her antics. A gorgeous trendy girl with no concept of boundaries and a dependable, doting high school boy... They're both hopelessly in love with each other, yet neither can bring themselves to confess in this sweet, frustratingly adorable romance!

title: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
blurb:
Being sexy can be mortifying, so who will be the first to tap out in this battle of flirtatious gazes between smitten seatmates Eguchi and Ikezawa?



Note: 
- Originally self-published, the manga got licensed by Shogakukan and started being published on Sunday Webry since June 17th, 2024. The original first chapter was republished with some changes, the subsequent chapters are being published without changes.
- Won 11th place in the Next Manga Award 2026 Web Manga Category.

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All
blurb: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad...

title: My Girlfriend Is a Colossal Cutie
blurb: Who says a short king can’t find love? In fact, not only does Amane have an adorably cute girlfriend with a smile that lights up the whole world, she also happens to be the tallest person in class! It may be a challenge for these two goofballs to work around their height differences—especially since they’re keeping it on the down-low to avoid being teased about it—but with a positive attitude and a lotta love, this height-gap romantic comedy will leave you wanting more!

title: Blue Lock
blurb:
After a disastrous defeat at the 2018 World Cup, Japan's team struggles to regroup. But what's missing? An absolute Ace Striker, who can guide them to the win. The Japan Football Union is hell-bent on creating a striker who hungers for goals and thirsts for victory, and who can be the decisive instrument in turning around a losing match...and to do so, they've gathered 300 of Japan's best and brightest youth players. Who will emerge to lead the team...and will they be able to out-muscle and out-ego everyone who stands in their way?



Note: Winner of the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2021.

title: The Witch and the Mercenary
blurb: Zig—a tall, broad-shouldered mercenary—participates in a witch hunt. Following a fierce duel with the deadly witch, he becomes privy to her desire. “I want you to protect me,” she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent!

title: Douyara Ore wa Imadoki Gal na Toshiue Osananajimi kara Gekiomo Kanjou wo Mukerareteirurashii
blurb: Yuito Kujo, a high school student, constantly compares himself to his exceptional older brother and sees himself as a lesser, "degraded version." Caught in a spiral of self-deprecation, his adolescence turns even darker when he discovers that his childhood crush, Suzuno, is in love with his older brother. But just as Yuito begins to lose hope, Suzuno's older sister, Kano—a college gal—develops intense, overwhelming feelings for him...!?

title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You
blurb:
Aijou Rentaro tried and tried again, but after asking a hundred girls out on a date, he was rejected every single time. In desperation, he prays for guidance…only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to some cosmic error! Now the god is going to set things right by making sure that Aijou gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often do with gods, the dates come with a catch: one hundred girls are destined to be Aijou’s soulmate, and unless he returns their feelings each and every time, they’ll die in horrible accidents! Sure enough, girls start confessing their love to Aijou left and right. But how is he supposed to choose?! He doesn’t want to kill anyone! When he looks at each potential soulmate, it feels like a bolt of lightning. Can someone really love a hundred other people? This hilarious romantic comedy takes the harem concept to a wild extreme!



Note: Won second place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category

title: One-Punch Man
blurb: In this new action-comedy, everything about a young man named Saitama screams "AVERAGE,” from his lifeless expression, to his bald head, to his unimpressive physique. However, this average-looking fellow doesn't have your average problem... He's actually a superhero that's looking for tough opponents! The problem is, every time he finds a promising candidate he beats the snot out of them in one punch. Can Saitama finally find an evil villain strong enough to challenge him? Follow Saitama through his hilarious romps as he searches for new bad guys to challenge!

title: Happy Harem Making with the Mightiest Orc!
blurb:
The weak stays virgin for life, the strong can XXXX hot women!!

Olc, the protagonist, was reincarnated into a half-orc child.
Seeing her child bullied in the village, his mother encourages him to become strong. She says:
“Olc, if you are weak, you’ll be a virgin for life. If you are strong, you’ll be able to XXXX beautiful women.”
He denies his mother’s words. However, after being shocked by the cuteness of the young girls from other races in a tribe meeting, he is determined to gain power. 
And thus, the journey of lust begins!

title: Akane-banashi
blurb:
Rakugo--the ultimate form of storytelling, where everything in a story is expressed with just your body and words. Shinta and his daughter Akane have been seduced by this wonderful form of classical entertainment. Having observed her father strive to pass the shin'uchi rakugo test, Akane will take her own steps into this unique world!



Notes:
- Ranked 3rd in the 8th Next Manga Awards print manga category in 2022.
- Ranked 4th in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 guidebook for male readers.
- Ranked 3rd in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees' Recommended Comics of 2023.
- Ranked 2nd in the 16th Manga Taisho in 2023.
- Nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Award in the shounen category in 2023.
- Included in the New York Public Library's 2023 Best Books for Teens.
- Included in YALSA's 2024 Great Graphic Novels for Teens.

title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru
blurb:
A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he’ll never trust a girl again.

But then, a pretty girl in his class suddenly starts talking to him a lot. Is she just trying to get to his brother too…? Or does she actually mean something else?

title: Kaikishita Ankoku Kenshi, Academy de Muzou Suru
blurb:
On a battlefield on the brink of annihilation, Gray Lee, a nameless foot soldier, lay with a spear piercing his chest, waiting for death. The most fearsome enemy—the [Executioner]—capable of burning the entire continent to the ground in a single day. The only ones capable of standing against him were the Sword Saint, the Divine Archer, the Grand Sage, and the Strongest Shield—the mightiest heroes of humanity. But even those heroes were falling one after another, and all hope seemed to be fading. —Or so it seemed. “...You’re still alive after being shot through the heart?”
Death did not come for Gray. He was guided by Chronos, the “Ruler of Time.” The moment he was granted an unknown dark power, he unleashed a devastating blow against the Settler, shaking the very fabric of fate. But just as victory seemed within reach, a beam of light flashed once more, and Gray’s body vanished into mist. At that moment, Chronos’s voice boomed.
“I’m sending you back to the past. Save this world.”
The next place he awoke in was his hometown, which was supposed to have been destroyed. It was the starting point of his “loser’s life” and the stage for a do-over. “This time, I’ll prove I can survive—”
Armed with the power to transcend time and memories of the future, Gray aims to become a warrior who surpasses even heroes. A revenge fantasy where past and future intersect now begins!

title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
blurb: This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path!

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
blurb:
“You useless son of mine! You were supposed to pull master swordsman, but I never thought it would be this tragic!”

The day a child turns fifteen, they undergo the Ritual of Divine Blessing. Already descended from a line of master swordsman, Elymas was supposed to succeed his father. However, he pulls the defective class, the Heavy Knight, and not only loses his status as future head of the household, but he's also exiled. With their unbalanced stats and seemingly useless skills, Heavy Knights are spoked of as a class for cowards and the lazy. However, Elymas knows the truth. The world he lives in is the same as the one of the game he used to play... It is the Heavy Knight that is the most powerful class of them all. Using memories from his past life, Elymas has set out to effectively conquer this entire world.

title: Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi.
blurb:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."

Working at a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? The is the start of an workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!

title: Berserk of Gluttony
blurb: Fate Graphite has never tasted true power. Born into a world with two kinds of people—those with superior skills and those without—he’s been shunned his entire life. Fate’s skill is Gluttony, a curse that leaves him constantly hungry… until he awakens its terrible potential. When he kills someone, he can devour their skills and feed his insatiable appetite. How many lives will it take for Fate’s Gluttony to finally be satisfied?

title: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken
Kurotsuki no Yaergnacht
blurb: While on his way home from an interview, unemployed, unmotivated, jaded 18-year-old Inumata Shinogi encounters the beautiful lady and evil spirit Yaergnacht Finsternnis. She demands him to either marry her or die on the spot. He must command the battle against enemies of humanityーthe apostles of god (Highlander), and save the world with his wife!! Battle fantasy with the infatuated strongest kuudere beauty, start!

title: Kingdom
blurb: Xin is a war orphan in a poor village in the kingdom of Qin. He has big dreams of becoming a great general, and when his best friend’s life is cut short by political machinations, Xin sets off to find a deposed ruler and help restore his place on the throne, while working his way up through the ranks of the Qin kingdom’s army to do what no one has ever done before—unify China.

title: Dandadan
blurb:
Momo Ayase strikes up an unusual friendship with her school’s UFO fanatic, whom she nicknames “Okarun” because he has a name that is not to be said aloud. While Momo believes in spirits, she thinks aliens are nothing but nonsense. Her new friend, meanwhile, thinks the exact opposite. To settle matters, the two set out to prove each other wrong—Momo to a UFO hotspot and Okarun to a haunted tunnel! What unfolds next is a beautiful story of young love…and oddly horny aliens and spirits?

 

Note: Nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho Award in 2022.

title: THE ISEKAI DOCTOR: Any sufficiently advanced medical science is indistinguishable from magic.
blurb: Amami is a kind doctor who always puts other people first. Struck by lightning and knocked unconscious, he woke up to find himself in a parallel world peopled by beast folk, with a chimera stalking around to boot! How will Amami fare as a doctor teleported to a strange world where technology is virtually nonexistent, and medicine is treated like magic?

title: Tokimori-san ga Muboubi desu!!
blurb: Tokimori-san is a beautiful and successful woman. But when she's off the job, she tends to be a bit absent-minded! Living together with the charming Tokimori-san always makes me nervous!

title: Inaka no Kuro Gal JK to Kekkon Shimashita
blurb:
Koichi quit his salaryman job to try to become a writer. However, he suffered from writer's block and he was unable to produce a novel.
He decides to move out of the city to live in his grandfather's studio for a change of scenery. Koichi is stunned by the empty countryside, but there he meets Ichika, a tanned high school gal who seems out of place in the rural town.

She is a sexually uninhibited girl who seems to be down to fuck at a moment's notice, but she is also a caring person, a good cook, and wants to settle down and get married, too. Koichi is attracted to Ichika, and he wants to make her the heroine of his novel… Somehow, they end up living together!
When Ichika invites him to have sex and make a baby with her, will Koichi be able to hold back long enough to finally complete his novel?

This is a slightly naughty story about how a sexually uninhibited girl becomes married to a novelist and have a child together.

title: Kizoku-ke Sannan no Nariagari Life
blurb:
An ordinary young man who lost his life in an accident meets the creator god who rules over another world!?

Reincarnated as the third son of a noble family by the power of God, he grows up healthy while being doted on by his family. However, even after reincarnation, many gods come one after another. Alline is favored by them and is given a lot of blessings, and before he knows it, he has powers far beyond the realm of humans.

Wanting to live a life without attracting attention, Alline enrolls in a magic school while hiding his abilities, and enjoys a fun school life in another world. However, troubles do not leave him alone. An assassin from a dark guild, a foolish noble who is plotting to overthrow the kingdom, and even a demon who defies God appear, and his life in the other world is in a mess.
"I can't stay silent now! In order to put an end to the big commotion that is involving the entire kingdom, I will release the power of the "God Class"!

title: Streaming My Second Life
blurb: Twenty years ago, legendary player Lee Suhyeok was killed by a trusted friend during a tower raid. Now he’s back, reincarnated in a much weaker body and forced to restart from level one. Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there’s no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming. As his stats rise with his view count, Suhyeok turns his revenge into a viral spectacle that no one, not even his killer, will ever see coming.

title: Fly Me to the Moon
blurb:
First comes marriage, then comes an earthbound love that is out of this world! From the day his parents named him, Nasa Yuzaki has been destined for outer space…or so he believes. But while trying to join the space program, he is thrown for a loop when an accident introduces him to Tsukasa, a mysterious girl with strange powers. Is she an alien, a moon goddess or something else? Since she insists on marrying him, Nasa has plenty of chances to find out!



Notes: The 16th volume includes the 4 chapter prequel "FLY ME TO THE MOON".

title: More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
blurb:
Jirou, a third-year in high school, is forced to live with a gyaru named Akari under a course called the "Couple Practical". In order to be paired with their own romantic interests, they're going to act as a married couple...!?
Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
blurb:
Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way-one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table.



Note: Winner of the 2023 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.

title: Isekai Craftsman: A Relaxing Tale of Chilling and Building from scratch
blurb: Miyabi, a "Crafter" who built his dream buildings in a VRMMO universe, suddenly finds himself transported to another world with his in-game skills along with him. Determined to live out his dream of a slow-paced life in this vast realm full of nature, Miyabi teams up with the adventurer Liz to gather materials! With his extraordinary crafting abilities, he's on a journey to enjoy a cozy and comfortable life.

title: ST✰R: Strike it Rich
blurb: After retiring from public fighting and getting fired from underground fighting, 27 year old Tenma Nozomi's zest for life is gradually dwindling away. It's hard to be at the bottom with nowhere to go, and that's exactly where she and her two friends are. However, Nozomi hits upon an idea that may just solve all of their problems: they could make their own underground fighting circuit for women, and tap into an underexplored market. As good as that sounds, her insistence on including the unknown quantity Hongou Hina may prove to be more than she bargained for...

title: Anatatachi Soredemo Sensei desu ka!
blurb: Cohabitation Romcom about a high school boy whose parents run an inn for a bunch of female teachers from his high school. However what are usually strict educators at work have a completely different, much more liberal attitude at home, getting the high school boy living with them in various lewd situations.

title: Kanojo ni Shitai Joshi Ichii, no Tonari de Mitsuketa Amari-chan
blurb:
Fukusuke, a nice but plain guy, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class, Yua. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend, the basketball ace, Yuusei. He is resigned to unrequited love as a background mob character, until he meets another super cute girl, Usuba Amari, who doesn't stand out because she is overshadowed by Yua.

“Um, w-would you be my friend?”

Fukusuke and Amari, caught in a similar situation, decide to start practicing "how to act normal" together.

title: Koukou Jidai ni Gouman Datta Joou-sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igai to Ikigokochi ga Warukunai
blurb:
Late at night, while working part-time at a convenience store, college student Yamamoto reunites with his former high school classmate, Megumi Hayashi. Back in school, she was known as the class’s most beautiful girl, yet also a proud and arrogant “queen.” Though the two didn’t get along in high school, Yamamoto discovers bruises on her wrist and, intending it to be just for one night, shelters her from her abusive boyfriend. Before he realizes it, however, a strange cohabitation begins.

Confused by the situation, the two gradually come to see sides of each other they never knew before. What was supposed to be the worst living arrangement turns out to be surprisingly comfortable…!?

A frustrating yet heart-fluttering romantic comedy about cohabitation between a wounded “queen” and an emotionally detached young man.

title: Shodai-sama no Kikan: Shijou Saikyou ga 1000-nengo no Shison ni Tensei Suru
blurb: Gilphas Eldragon, the founding patriarch of the Eldragon family, dedicated his entire life to the pursuit of absolute strength. In search of eternal combat, he consumed a legendary fruit rumored to grant immortality under the protection of the divine dragon. Yet the rumor was false—Gilphas aged, and in the end, passed away in his son’s arms. Or so it seemed. When he next opened his eyes, Gilphas found himself reborn a thousand years later as Zeke Eldragon, heir to his own bloodline. But the world had changed: the Eldragon clan now thrived under a ruthless creed of survival of the fittest, and a new threat known as the “Chaos” loomed over humanity. Faced with an unfamiliar era and even greater enemies, the ancient warrior feels only exhilaration. For Gilphas—now Zeke—this is the chance he longed for: “This time, I will witness the true end of martial strength!”

title: Berserk
blurb:
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned—and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.



Notes:
- Volumes 1-5 contain the 16 prequel chapters 0A - 0P.
- Chapter 83 was omitted from Volume 13 due to the author’s request.
- Volume 14 includes “Berserk: The Prototype”.
- Due to the author's passing, starting from Chapter 365, the manga is illustrated by Studio Gaga (Miura's assistants) and supervised by Kouji Mori (a close friend of Miura's).

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
blurb: Iruma Suzuki has always been eager to please, even at the cost of his well-being. Worst yet, he's the son of two selfish parents who end up selling him to a demon. Thanks to their totally irresponsible actions, Iruma has found himself living in the Netherworld, where he must live and attend school as the grandson of an older demon. Luckily, his new, doting grandfather is there to help, but Iruma will have to figure out how to blend in with his demonic classmates or risk getting eaten. All he needs to do is subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and do other typical demon things while never revealing that he's human… Piece of cake, right?

title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Party Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to an Infinite Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge
blurb: A kid named Light is the only human member of the adventuring party Legion of Races, but humans are by far the weakest race in his world. When his comrades abandon him to the lowest levels of a dungeon, Light resorts to the gift of Infinite Gacha to create a harem of Lvl 9999 allies! With his powerful and beautiful new friends by his side, can Light escape the dungeon and exact vengeance upon the Legion of Races…and the entire world?

title: Gorin no Megami-sama: Nadeshiko Ryou no Medal Gohan
blurb: The protagonist, Kominato Ryou, whose only skill is cooking, is accepted by his father into the prestigious Itadaki High School, on the condition that he work as a cook at the residence. However, the "dorm" is a female dorm where future gold medalists live. The dietary demands of these high-level athletes are naturally high. Accept the challenge to fill their stomachs and prepare their bodies for the Olympics! A group of schoolgirls + an Olympic gourmet! The delicious harem romantic comedy begins!

title: 7-nin no Nemuri Hime
blurb:
I want to wake up the princess who was put to sleep by a witch's curse… but there are seven of them!
So it seems that I have to kiss...... seven girls!
Now the princesses are awake, but the other people in the kingdom are still asleep...... Why?
Is there more to breaking the curse than just a kiss or am I still missing something......?

Alec is the third prince of Rudbekia who wants to save the kingdom of Amaryllis and its seven princesses.
In a country where only they are awake, they must work together to save everyone from the curse!

title: Ougon no Keikenchi
blurb:
The protagonist Leah, a girl who participated in the closed beta test of "Boot Hour, Shoot Curse", a new VRMMORPG that has no concept of levels or professions. Instead, players must farm experience points to gain new skills and increase their status.
Leah has acquired the hidden skill "Subordinate", which allows her to turn NPCs and monsters into her subordinates. The skill also transfers the experience points gained by the subordinates to herself. Continuously strengthening herself and her subordinates with accumulating experience points, she inadvertently received the classification of a Demon Lord...!?

title: Bouryoku Banzai
blurb: Masamichi Akita, a high school student whose motto is to live wisely, who meets Setsuna Rikudou, a high school girl with a violent supremacist attitude. Akita is saved by Rikudou when he is tangled up with a delinquent, and is attracted by her overwhelming strength, asks her to teach him how to fight. However, Akita is devastated by Rikudou, who asserts that "violence is the only rule in this world". Akita's encounter with Rikudou leads him into the world of "violence".

title: 7th
blurb: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family?
